parameters.content:
## TEKAGENT Homewatch cutover
React/PWA field app -> Supabase is the durable source of truth. n8n owns monthly orchestration only.

Billing contract:
1. One Stripe invoice per owner/customer per billing month, regardless of number of visits or properties.
2. Every visit is a separate invoice line: date + Homewatch Visit + property + optional visit note.
3. Handyman/other charges are separate invoice lines beneath that visit.
4. batchId is deterministic (hw:<YYYY-MM>:<stripeCustomerId>) and must be screened across draft/open/paid/void/uncollectible before invoice creation.
5. Visit billing_month_override takes precedence over visit_date for late visits.
6. Never invoice held/unmapped visits.

Before activation:
1. Bind HOMEWATCH bridge authentication using an n8n credential, not plaintext workflow JSON.
2. Test the last-day review.
3. Bind a restricted Royal Palms Stripe credential.
4. Add Stripe duplicate-screen + invoice-item + finalize/send + mark-billed nodes.
5. Verify owner notes render on the Stripe invoice.
6. Only after end-to-end Stripe testing, remove the activation guard.

Never make n8n the only copy of a field report; the TEKAGENT ledger is primary.
